environment.description: Same application deployed behind AWS AppSync with a pipeline resolver configuration. The AppSync endpoint defines a strict GraphQL schema with request mapping templates that enforce VTL-based input validation. Specifically, the request mapping template for the 'searchUsers' query applies $util.matches() with pattern '^[\\w\\s@.\\-]{1,128}$' on the 'filter' argument and $util.error() on mismatch. The 'getUser' resolver template validates ID with '^[a-f0-9\\-]{1,36}$'. AppSync's built-in resolver-level payload size enforcement caps individual string arguments at 200KB (well above the regex limit but below what matters since the regex rejects first). The pipeline uses a 'BEFORE' function slot that runs validation prior to the Lambda datasource invocation. Note: the application code itself still has no input validation - all protection is at the AppSync layer.

config.compute_backend: Lambda (same app code wrapped in serverless-http)
